notes: Figma canvas (WebGL): values measured from a 103% zoom screenshot, divided by 1.03. Inspect panel unavailable without login, so sizes are ~approx (±1px); colors sampled from pixels.

colors.role: status In Process / To Verify (purple) bg/text

taste.name: Tone instead of elevation
taste.trigger: When separating 17 task cards from the board background
taste.decision: Chose flat #FFFFFF cards on a #F7F8FA board with no border and no shadow over shadowed/bordered cards
taste.reason: Because with a dozen-plus cards on screen, a shadow on each produces a dozen competing edges; a tonal step keeps the board readable as a grid of text
evidence: card edge goes directly #F7F8FA → #FFFFFF, no shadow pixels

taste.name: Color only where status lives
taste.trigger: When encoding task state (Backlog, To Do, In Process, To Verify, Done)
taste.decision: Chose ~10px tinted pills and matching column counters as the only saturated color over colored column headers or card backgrounds
taste.reason: Because scanning for state works when hue appears only where state is encoded; everything else stays in two grays
evidence: status pills: pink #DB2777, purple #9333EA, green #16A34A, amber
column counters reuse the same tint per status

taste.name: Fixed columns, variable cards
taste.trigger: When laying out workflow columns on a 1600px frame
taste.decision: Chose 4 columns of fixed ~264px with 24px gaps over fluid columns that stretch to fill width
taste.reason: Because a fixed column keeps card titles at a constant line length (2 lines max) and the eye scans the same horizontal positions in every column

taste.name: One shell surface, hairline seams
taste.trigger: When splitting sidebar, header, board and member rail
taste.decision: Chose a single #F7F8FA background for all four regions divided by 1px #E9EBF0 lines over a dark or contrasting sidebar
taste.reason: Because the chrome recedes and white cards become the only foreground layer, so attention lands on tasks, not navigation
evidence: sidebar, header, main and rail all sample #F7F8FA
